dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Dear homeland, and dear relatives, I never imagined that our day of parting would come so soon."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's all thanks to this investment coupon from Mimisbrunnr Books. My days as a penniless, luckless pauper are now far behind me!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Tomorrow, I'll be enjoying afternoon tea at the Hotel Debord, and in a few days, I'll be able to enjoy the golden sun shining down on the cliffs from Mt. Tianheng. This world truly is vast beyond compare!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Do not worry, dear loved ones, bosom friends. I'll spend all this money. Yes, every last Mora! And with that, I bid you tally-ho!"
